```{r}
# Quantitative upgrade for Fig. 7c
#
# Run after `health_sf` has been created in equity-health.Rmd.
# The analysis pairs the same LSOAs under Green30 and Target30 and uses
# Green30 benefit tertiles as fixed reference thresholds for both scenarios.

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(cowplot)

outcome_keep <- "All_cause"
scenario_keep <- c("Green30", "Target30")
vulnerability_vars <- c(
  "pIncomeDeprivation",
  "p75over",
  "pBAME"
)

vulnerability_labels <- c(
  pIncomeDeprivation = "Income deprivation",
  p75over = "Age ≥75",
  pBAME = "Ethnic minority"
)

# Identify an optional LSOA population field. Add the exact field name here if
# the source GeoPackage uses a different name. The core analysis remains valid
# without it and will then report LSOA percentages only.
population_candidates <- c(
  "population", "Population", "population_2021", "Population_2021",
  "total_population", "pop_2021", "pop"
)
population_matches <- intersect(population_candidates, names(health_sf))
population_var <- if (length(population_matches) > 0) {
  population_matches[[1]]
} else {
  character(0)
}
has_population <- length(population_var) == 1

required_vars <- c(
  "id", "indicator", "lc_scenario", "cases", vulnerability_vars
)
missing_vars <- setdiff(required_vars, names(health_sf))
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns in health_sf: ", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "))
}

select_vars <- c(required_vars, if (has_population) population_var)

equity_long <- health_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(
    indicator == outcome_keep,
    as.character(lc_scenario) %in% scenario_keep
  ) %>%
  select(all_of(select_vars)) %>%
  mutate(lc_scenario = as.character(lc_scenario)) %>%
  distinct(id, lc_scenario, .keep_all = TRUE)

duplicate_check <- equity_long %>%
  count(id, lc_scenario) %>%
  filter(n != 1)
if (nrow(duplicate_check) > 0) {
  stop("Each id must have exactly one row per scenario.")
}

pair_check <- equity_long %>%
  count(id) %>%
  filter(n != length(scenario_keep))
if (nrow(pair_check) > 0) {
  warning(nrow(pair_check), " LSOAs do not have both scenarios and will be excluded.")
}

equity_wide <- equity_long %>%
  select(
    id, lc_scenario, cases, all_of(vulnerability_vars),
    any_of(population_var)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(id, all_of(vulnerability_vars), any_of(population_var)),
    names_from = lc_scenario,
    values_from = cases,
    names_prefix = "cases_"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cases_Green30), !is.na(cases_Target30)) %>%
  mutate(
    population = if (has_population) .data[[population_var]] else 1,
    delta_cases = cases_Target30 - cases_Green30
  )

# Use Green30 as the fixed benefit reference. This avoids redefining "low
# benefit" within each scenario and makes scenario transitions interpretable.
green30_ecdf <- ecdf(equity_wide$cases_Green30)

classify_benefit <- function(x) {
  p <- green30_ecdf(x)
  case_when(
    p <= 1 / 3 ~ "Low",
    p <= 2 / 3 ~ "Moderate",
    TRUE ~ "High"
  )
}

benefit_levels <- c("Low", "Moderate", "High")

metric_data <- map_dfr(vulnerability_vars, function(metric_name) {
  equity_wide %>%
    transmute(
      id,
      metric = metric_name,
      metric_label = unname(vulnerability_labels[metric_name]),
      vulnerability = .data[[metric_name]],
      vulnerability_percentile = percent_rank(vulnerability),
      high_vulnerability = vulnerability_percentile >= 2 / 3,
      population,
      cases_Green30,
      cases_Target30,
      delta_cases,
      benefit_Green30 = factor(
        classify_benefit(cases_Green30), levels = benefit_levels
      ),
      benefit_Target30 = factor(
        classify_benefit(cases_Target30), levels = benefit_levels
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(vulnerability), !is.na(high_vulnerability))
})

# Headline table: prevalence of the blue class, paired transitions, magnitude
# of additional benefit, and citywide benefit retention.
headline_results <- metric_data %>%
  filter(high_vulnerability) %>%
  group_by(metric, metric_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_high_vulnerability = n(),
    population_high_vulnerability = sum(population, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_blue_Green30 = sum(benefit_Green30 == "Low"),
    n_blue_Target30 = sum(benefit_Target30 == "Low"),
    pct_blue_Green30 = 100 * mean(benefit_Green30 == "Low"),
    pct_blue_Target30 = 100 * mean(benefit_Target30 == "Low"),
    change_blue_percentage_points = pct_blue_Target30 - pct_blue_Green30,
    n_blue_resolved = sum(
      benefit_Green30 == "Low" & benefit_Target30 != "Low"
    ),
    pct_Green30_blue_resolved = 100 * n_blue_resolved / n_blue_Green30,
    n_new_blue = sum(
      benefit_Green30 != "Low" & benefit_Target30 == "Low"
    ),
    additional_deaths_averted = sum(delta_cases, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_change_deaths_averted = 100 *
      (sum(cases_Target30, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(cases_Green30, na.rm = TRUE) - 1),
    population_pct_blue_Green30 = 100 * weighted.mean(
      benefit_Green30 == "Low", population, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    population_pct_blue_Target30 = 100 * weighted.mean(
      benefit_Target30 == "Low", population, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    weighting = if (has_population) population_var else "LSOA counts",
    population_change_blue_percentage_points =
      population_pct_blue_Target30 - population_pct_blue_Green30
  )

citywide_results <- equity_wide %>%
  summarise(
    deaths_averted_Green30 = sum(cases_Green30, na.rm = TRUE),
    deaths_averted_Target30 = sum(cases_Target30, na.rm = TRUE),
    difference = deaths_averted_Target30 - deaths_averted_Green30,
    Target30_retention_pct = 100 * deaths_averted_Target30 / deaths_averted_Green30
  )

# Exact paired transitions among high-vulnerability LSOAs.
transition_results <- metric_data %>%
  filter(high_vulnerability) %>%
  count(
    metric, metric_label, benefit_Green30, benefit_Target30,
    name = "n_LSOA"
  ) %>%
  group_by(metric, metric_label, benefit_Green30) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_within_Green30_class = 100 * n_LSOA / sum(n_LSOA)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Focused transition summary for LSOAs that were blue under Green30.
blue_transitions <- metric_data %>%
  filter(high_vulnerability, benefit_Green30 == "Low") %>%
  count(metric, metric_label, benefit_Target30, name = "n_LSOA") %>%
  group_by(metric, metric_label) %>%
  complete(
    benefit_Target30 = factor(benefit_levels, levels = benefit_levels),
    fill = list(n_LSOA = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n_LSOA / sum(n_LSOA)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Panel C1: the blue-class gap. A downward slope indicates improvement.
blue_plot_data <- headline_results %>%
  select(
    metric_label,
    Green30 = pct_blue_Green30,
    Target30 = pct_blue_Target30
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Green30, Target30),
    names_to = "scenario",
    values_to = "pct_blue"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scenario_keep),
    metric_label = factor(
      metric_label,
      levels = unname(vulnerability_labels[vulnerability_vars])
    )
  )

p_blue_gap <- ggplot(
  blue_plot_data,
  aes(x = scenario, y = pct_blue, group = metric_label)
) +
  geom_line(color = "grey65", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(color = scenario), size = 3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct_blue)),
    nudge_y = 2.5,
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric_label, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Green30 = "#4D4D4D", Target30 = "#007C91")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number(suffix = "%"),
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "High-vulnerability LSOAs\nreceiving relatively low benefit",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# Panel C2: what happened to the same blue LSOAs after targeting?
p_blue_transition <- ggplot(
  blue_transitions,
  aes(x = metric_label, y = pct, fill = benefit_Target30)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = if_else(pct >= 7, paste0(round(pct), "%\n(n=", n_LSOA, ")"), "")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 2.8,
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Low = "#3B77A6", Moderate = "#86C5B5", High = "#006D5B"),
    labels = c(
      Low = "Remained low benefit",
      Moderate = "Shifted to moderate benefit",
      High = "Shifted to high benefit"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(scale = 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Outcome under Target30 among\nGreen30 blue-class LSOAs",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

fig7c_upgraded <- plot_grid(
  p_blue_gap,
  p_blue_transition,
  labels = c("c", "d"),
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 1.15),
  label_size = 11
)

dir.create("./figures/equity_map_biscale", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(
  headline_results,
  "./figures/equity_map_biscale/fig7_quantitative_headline_results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  transition_results,
  "./figures/equity_map_biscale/fig7_paired_transition_matrix.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  citywide_results,
  "./figures/equity_map_biscale/fig7_citywide_tradeoff.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  "./figures/equity_map_biscale/fig7c_upgraded.png",
  fig7c_upgraded,
  width = 7,
  height = 6.2,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white",
  device = ragg::agg_png
)

print(headline_results)
print(citywide_results)
print(fig7c_upgraded)

```
